basics.name: Doruk Doğan
basics.title: Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist
basics.summary: Versatile Digital Marketing Professional with 3+ years of enterprise experience driving commercial growth across international markets. Expert in Performance Media campaign management, Technical SEO site health optimizations, and Omnichannel web operations for global brands including Rituals, Philips, and Haleon. A high-agency problem solver who builds custom AI tools and automation pipelines to streamline complex workflows.

pillars.title: Performance Marketing & Paid Social
pillars.subtitle: ROAS-driven ad operations across EU markets
pillars.description: Designed and executed high-impact performance media plans on TikTok, Meta, Pinterest, and Snapchat. Managed complex product catalogs and dynamic ad feeds via Smartly.io.

pillars.title: Technical SEO & Search Strategy
pillars.subtitle: Data-led site health, architecture & keyword clusters
pillars.description: Led in-depth technical SEO audits, crawl budget optimizations, and semantic keyword cluster analyses for major enterprise brands including Eurowings, Lineage Logistics, and Wolters Kluwer.

pillars.title: Omnichannel Web Operations & A/B Testing
pillars.subtitle: Enterprise CMS localization & experimentation
pillars.description: Managed multi-market page rollouts in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), executed A/B experimentation programs via Adobe Target, and handled Amazon digital shelf operations.

experience.summary: Embedded within world-class brand teams to lead performance media operations, SEO technical health, and omnichannel web localization.
highlights: Managed end-to-end SEO strategies and technical optimizations for a diverse portfolio of international clients.
Delivered multi-market digital marketing initiatives across consumer electronics, retail, and healthcare brands.

experience.summary: Executed high-impact performance media campaigns across 16+ European markets.
highlights: Managed performance campaigns on TikTok, Meta, and Pinterest driving commercial conversion and measurable ROAS.
Operated complex product catalogs and feeds via Smartly.io and Meta Business Manager.
Managed major retail campaigns including Dream, Sakura, Karma, Advent, Christmas, Easter, Mother's Day, and Summer Gifting across NL, BE, DE, FR, UK, IE, DK, NO, SE, FI, ES, PT, IT, PL, RO, AT, CH.

experience.summary: Led strategic oversight of User-Generated Content (UGC) across TikTok and Instagram.
highlights: Architected an API-based content pipeline to automate tracking and sorting of creator stories, overcoming platform rate limits during peak retail volume.
Monitored real-time brand safety and community sentiment for creator integrations.

experience.summary: Delivered enterprise web localization and conversion rate experimentation.
highlights: Implemented and localized enterprise web pages in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) supporting global multi-market launches.
Led A/B testing in Adobe Target to identify growth levers; analyzed data in Adobe Analytics and Google Analytics to guide site optimizations.

experience.summary: Managed and optimized digital retail content on Amazon Vendor Central.
highlights: Tracked digital shelf KPIs, aligned product content to shopper intent, and managed catalog feeds via ProductsUp.

experience.summary: Conducted technical audits and search strategy for enterprise clients.
highlights: Audited search performance for Eurowings, Crum & Forster, BailUSA, Lineage Logistics, Redwoods, Wolters Kluwer, and TP Vision.
Conducted deep keyword research, topic clustering, crawl budget error fixes, and on-page optimizations.
Led UX/UI redesign and optimization for the company internal intranet in Figma and AEM.
